title: STAR-GRPO: Canonical Anchoring and Reliability-First Advantages against Representation-Dependent Reward Hacking
abstract: arXiv:2609.36900v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Reward hacking occurs when policy optimization exploits a brittle reward interface or an overly permissive proxy objective, improving the training score without improving the underlying response quality. This phenomenon is amplified in group-relative policy optimization: an unsupported reward can shift the group baseline and alter the updates of other rollouts, while post-hoc or purely relative weighting cannot represent group-wide uncertainty. We propose \emph{Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization} (STAR-GRPO), a reliability-first advantage estimator based on paired assessments of the same rollout. STAR separates the quality signal from its learning influence: score disagreement determines rollout reliability, relative reliability enters a self-tuned robust location--scale fit before group normalization, and absolute group reliability attenuates the resulting bounded advantage. translated_title: STAR-GRPO：以规范锚定与可靠性优先的优势估计对抗表征依赖的奖励欺骗
translated_abstract: 当策略优化利用脆弱的奖励接口或过于宽松的代理目标，在不提升底层响应质量的情况下提高训练分数时，就会发生奖励欺骗现象。该现象在组相对策略优化中被放大：一个缺乏依据的奖励会移动组基线并改变其他采样轨迹的更新，而事后处理或纯相对加权无法表征组级的不确定性。我们提出了自调优锚定可靠性组相对策略优化（Self-Tuned Anchored Reliability Group-Relative Policy Optimization，STAR-GRPO），一种基于对同一采样轨迹进行成对评估的可靠性优先优势估计器。STAR将质量信号与其学习影响分离：分数分歧决定采样轨迹的可靠性，相对可靠性在组归一化之前进入自调优的稳健位置–尺度拟合，而绝对组可靠性则对由此产生的有界优势进行衰减。分析建立了坐标……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 提出STAR-GRPO，一种可靠性优先的优势估计方法，通过对同一响应的成对评估将质量信号与学习影响分离，利用自调优的稳健位置–尺度拟合与组可靠性衰减机制，有效抑制GRPO中依赖表征的奖励欺骗问题。
en_tdlr: STAR-GRPO is a reliability-first advantage estimator that separates the quality signal from its learning influence through paired assessments of the same rollout, using self-tuned robust location-scale fitting and group-reliability attenuation to counter representation-dependent reward hacking in GRPO.
